question: Can one frozen relational verifier recover known SCAR candidates contributed by scientific SAE retrieval while separately measuring dense-hit retention?

scope.dataset: SCAR English bidirectional cross-domain retrieval proxy
scope.reason: The complete SCAR retrieval result and its rescue behavior have already been inspected.

development_population.retention_selection: SHA-256 order over dense-top-10 successes whose canonical pair is absent from the rescue stratum
development_population.use: outcome-stratified screening on a fully inspected development benchmark; no population Recall claim

candidate_generation.sae_source_union: stable deduplicated union of dense top-10, cs.LG SAE top-10, and astro.PH SAE top-10; retained unpadded only for source-oracle reporting and feature selection
candidate_generation.verifier_pool_matching: append the next-best unused dense candidates to every SAE and random source union until it contains exactly 30 unique candidates; never drop a source-union member
candidate_generation.random_source_union: stable deduplicated union of dense top-10 and two independently seeded random-projection top-10 lists
candidate_generation.random_oracle_rule: report all 64 unpadded source-oracle results; never select the best seed pair; the first three prespecified pairs enter verification
candidate_generation.random_control_scope: matched on dictionary width, top-k sparsity, number of representations, and exact 30-candidate verifier budget; not claimed to match learned SAE activation statistics

feature_evidence.selection: highest aggregate IDF-weighted shared activation across every SAE-union query-candidate pair, without qrels
feature_evidence.description_shuffle: within each representation, sort by corpus-active frequency, split into eight equal-count bins, hash-order each bin, and apply a one-step cyclic derangement frozen before descriptions are generated
feature_evidence.coherence_rule: a feature enters any evidence arm only when both its aligned description and frozen shuffled donor description have coherent=true
feature_evidence.direct_example_rule: a feature enters any evidence arm only when neither pair member occurs anywhere in either the aligned or donor description's exact batched request context
feature_evidence.common_evidence_set: activation-only, aligned-description, and shuffled-description modes receive identical opaque aliases, ordering, and activation percentiles; only description presence/text differs
feature_evidence.usable_features_per_pair: 0 to 3 after common coherence and direct-example filtering
feature_evidence.interpretation: aligned minus activation-only tests incremental description value; aligned minus shuffled-description tests whether semantic alignment, rather than generic extra text, matters

pre_verifier_smoke_amendment.known_before_change: 73/73 mechanism graphs and 208/256 descriptions had completed; one eight-feature description response repeatedly omitted R2:F0509; no verifier scores or qrels-based evaluation had been produced
pre_verifier_smoke_amendment.diagnostic: R2:F0509 succeeded alone and in its deterministic four-feature half-batch
pre_verifier_smoke_amendment.change: freeze description batches at four features and regenerate all descriptions under that uniform context size

pre_evaluation_smoke_amendment.known_before_change: 73/73 mechanisms, 256/256 descriptions, and 122/166 verifier predictions had completed; one feature-grounded response repeatedly assigned nonzero feature_support to an empty-evidence pair; no qrels-based evaluation had run
pre_evaluation_smoke_amendment.change: preserve the raw model fields, but deterministically set feature_support=0 and accidental_feature_overlap=false before scoring whenever shared_feature_evidence is empty
pre_evaluation_smoke_amendment.rationale: this enforces the existing evidence-only rubric invariant rather than changing an endpoint

pre_screen_design_amendment.known_before_change: The two-query non-evidentiary smoke, its 27/83 usable-evidence coverage, the full-corpus source-oracle totals 200/566 SAE and 193/566 for the legacy random seed pair, and mean unpadded pool sizes 19.11 SAE and 22.10 random were known. No 108-query verifier predictions or evaluation had been produced.
changes: pad every verifier candidate pool to exactly 30 with next-unused dense candidates while preserving unpadded source pools for oracle reporting
add activation-only and within-frequency-bin shuffled-description controls on one common evidence set
expand random source-oracle diagnostics to 64 prespecified seed pairs and carry the first three into verification
freeze qrels-free coverage and maximum-batch operational checks
freeze numerical full-go, narrow-go, and no-go rules before the development screen

mechanism_extraction.pair_specific_breakpoints: produced only by the blinded verifier, never invented for one system in isolation

verifier.external_processing: extract and describe send SCAR names/backgrounds; verify sends derived graphs and eligible feature descriptions; explicit authorization is required
verifier.ranking_score: fixed deterministic function of integer rubric fields
verifier.empty_evidence_postprocessing: retain raw evidence-only fields, then force feature_support=0 and accidental_feature_overlap=false before scoring when the pair has no shared feature evidence
verifier.batching: one immutable deterministic ordered/chunked superpool plan per query; identical candidates, aliases, positions, and common feature rows are scored in structure, activation-only, aligned-description, and shuffled-description modes
verifier.missing_or_stale_result_policy: abort rather than silently bottom-rank or mix provenance

arms.dense30_structure: Dense top-30 ranked by the structure-only pair verifier
arms.sae_union_padded30_structure: SAE source union padded to 30, ranked by the identical structure-only verifier
arms.random_union_padded30_structure_1: Prespecified random source union 1 padded to 30, ranked by the identical structure-only verifier
arms.random_union_padded30_structure_2: Prespecified random source union 2 padded to 30, ranked by the identical structure-only verifier
arms.random_union_padded30_structure_3: Prespecified random source union 3 padded to 30, ranked by the identical structure-only verifier
arms.sae_union_padded30_activation_only: The same SAE-padded pool with opaque aliases and activation percentiles but no descriptions
arms.sae_union_padded30_aligned_description: The same SAE-padded pool with correctly aligned frozen descriptions
arms.sae_union_padded30_shuffled_description: The same SAE-padded pool with frozen within-representation, frequency-bin-matched donor descriptions

primary_diagnostics: SAE-padded structure verifier minus dense-30 structure verifier
SAE-padded structure verifier minus each of three prespecified random-padded structure verifiers
aligned-description minus structure-only and activation-only on the identical SAE-padded pool
aligned-description minus shuffled-description on the identical evidence rows
development_readout.uncertainty: separate canonical-pair clustered intervals by stratum plus a 10,000-resample stratified paired bootstrap positive fraction for net utility
development_readout.interpretation: outcome-stratified exploratory method screening only; pooled screen rates are descriptive and no p-value or interval is confirmatory

pre_screen_operational_gate.failure_policy: repair only an implementation or API-compatibility defect without viewing qrels-based outcomes; otherwise stop before the 108-query verifier screen

development_go_no_rule.candidate_source_gate: the 200-hit unpadded SAE source oracle must exceed the higher-method 95th percentile of all 64 random oracles with plus-one tail probability at most 0.05; SAE structure must also pass the absolute thresholds and beat dense-30 plus every one of the three prespecified random controls by the margin and stability thresholds
development_go_no_rule.feature_grounding_gate: aligned descriptions must pass the absolute and coverage thresholds and beat structure-only, activation-only, and shuffled descriptions by the margin and stability thresholds, without fewer rescues or more than one additional dense loss
development_go_no_rule.random_match_policy: a net-utility margin below five, or a paired bootstrap positive fraction below 0.90, fails; an exact margin of five passes this component

decision_policy.full_go: candidate-source and feature-grounding gates both pass; freeze both for an external benchmark
decision_policy.narrow_structure_go: candidate-source passes and feature-grounding fails; drop feature-grounding as a contribution
decision_policy.narrow_feature_go: candidate-source fails but the full feature gate passes and aligned descriptions also clear the dense-30 and all-random diagnostic utility guardrails; make no candidate-source-specificity claim
decision_policy.no_go: all other outcomes stop Structural Rescue on SCAR; do not tune thresholds, prompts, scoring, seeds, or reshuffle descriptions

stop_rules: Do not modify the frozen retrieval, Latent Escape, or Latent Choice protocols.
Do not expose qrels or rescue labels to extraction, feature description, or verification.
Do not tune on or reuse the 120 untouched Latent Choice prompts.
Dense and random arm ordering on the outcome-selected screen is diagnostic only and cannot establish confirmatory SAE specificity.
Do not change the three prespecified verifier random controls or select a favorable draw from the 64-pair oracle distribution.
Treat aligned-minus-activation and aligned-minus-shuffled comparisons as development evidence about description semantics, separate from candidate-source value.
Because 24 query superpools span two fixed request batches, treat any aligned-description advantage as a batch-level verifier-method effect rather than local explanation faithfulness.
After any qrels-based 108-query result is opened, do not alter prompts, scoring, pools, seeds, shuffle mapping, thresholds, or feature eligibility.
A passing screen licenses only method freezing and evaluation on an outcome-independent external benchmark.
Do not run a confirmatory analysis until the complete method and an independent benchmark are frozen.
